candidates.what: Dusk exterior of a strip-mall 'Egghead Discount Software' storefront: illuminated red sign, lit shop windows, a window poster reading 'Egghead is your new computer's best friend'. Composition and lighting suggest a professional or corporate photograph, not a snapshot.

candidates.unverified_lead: The blog links Egghead's archived reports at UW Libraries alongside these photos. The picture may come from an Egghead annual report other than 1995 (1989-1994 and 1996-1999 were not page-checked). A report scan would give a higher-resolution primary source. Its rights would still be In Copyright under Egghead, so the rights question would not go away.
